title: Mary Ann Simpson
bodyHtml:
Mary Ann grew up in New Jersey and moved to Massachusetts where she graduated from Northeastern University. She received her formal art training at the Rhode Island School of Design majoring in illustration.

Mary Ann is a participating member of the Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists. She also displays her art each Monday at Art in the Park in Harwich Port during the summer. Her paintings include landscapes, lighthouses seascapes, florals, wildlife and many other subjects. Many of her paintings are local Cape Cod scenes. Mary Ann paints in both oil and watercolor.

The Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists
551 Route 28
Harwich Port, MA
